method: Market-price verification against raw researched catalog values. Every actual published product in English and Japanese at 1440, 390 and 320px, plus all nonempty maker-region contexts, all product cards, the earrings comparison, representatives and the home hero. A zero-sized unknown-price published set is recorded explicitly without inventing an item. Checks visible currency/amount/date, matching official market destination, sticky purchase meaning, language roundtrip, overflow and 18 accessibility scans with every axe rule enabled. Source data hashes are compared at completion. Does not use the UI price helper to generate expected figures, open merchant checkouts, claim shelf prices or perform currency conversion.
